capabilities.description: Review the range or pinned record a brief names with the agent the BOARD_REVIEW_AGENT variable names, and write the report beside the brief.

inputSchema.description: Review the range or record a brief names with the agent BOARD_REVIEW_AGENT names.

brief.description: The brief to run, by its logical path, such as /reviews/fix-sync/brief.
brief.title: Brief

inputSchema.title: RunInput

capabilities.name: run

Subject.description: A record under review, pinned by its blob, so a review names exactly which version it read.
Subject.title: Subject

outputSchema.description: The report written, the commits or record it covers, the verdict and how many findings.
outputSchema.title: RunOutput

capabilities.description: Comment a report on a GitHub pull request with gh, once the owner approves the whole comment through `board decide`, and set the report's source to the comment's URL. A report whose source is set is skipped.

inputSchema.description: Post a report as a comment on a pull request, once the owner approves the comment.

pr.description: The pull request to comment on, by its URL, such as https://github.com/o/r/pull/7.
pr.title: Pr

report.description: The report to post, by its logical path, such as /reviews/fix-sync/report.
report.title: Report

inputSchema.title: PostInput

capabilities.name: post

outputSchema.description: The comment's URL, from the report's `source` when it was already posted, and whether this call posted it.
outputSchema.title: PostOutput

capabilities.description: The reports in the board's own tree that cover every commit from the merge base of a base and a head to the head, each by a report's range or patch ids, after skipping commits that only add review records. A report asking for changes never covers. Fails when a commit is uncovered.

inputSchema.description: Whether a committed report covers the commits a pull request adds to its base.

base.description: The commit the pull request merges into, in any form git resolves, such as its base commit.
base.title: Base

head.description: The commit to check, in any form git resolves, such as a pull request's head commit; HEAD when left out.
head.title: Head

inputSchema.title: CoveredInput

capabilities.name: covered

outputSchema.description:
The commit checked, its merge base with the base, and the reports that cover the commits between.

`skipped` counts the commits that only add review records and need no
report, `commits` the rest, and `reports` lists the reports that cover at
least one of them.
outputSchema.title: CoveredOutput

description: Review briefs, the reports a clean-context agent or a person writes for them, and whether a commit is covered by reports. `board call review.run --brief /reviews/<id>/brief` reviews the brief's range or pinned record with the agent BOARD_REVIEW_AGENT names and records the report; `board call review.post --report /reviews/<id>/report --pr <url>` comments it on a pull request once the owner approves the comment; `board call review.covered --base <commit> --head <commit>` checks that committed reports cover a pull request's commits. README.md in the plugin's directory says more.
name: review
